theorem_title: The extended counting domain has no repeated entries
natural_language_statement:
Let $D$ be the list obtained by concatenating the complement of $G=\{122,183,244,366,732\}$ in $\{1,\ldots,732\}$, the gadget list $G$, and $[733,734]$. Then

$$
D\text{ has no duplicate entries}.
$$

This counting-interface lemma ensures that filtering the domain measures set cardinality rather than multiplicity.
